The UKRI-funded project **[SynPAI](https://synpaim.wordpress.com/) — Synergising Process-Based and Machine Learning Models for Accurate and Explainable Crop Yield Prediction along with Environmental Impact Assessment** started in February 2024 and ran until September 2025, with Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava as principal investigator.
